All Classes and Interfaces

Class
Description
Actor
An abstract class that represents an object that exists in the WorldScene.
Assets
Loads the game's level files from disk
Calc
A static utility class that contains methods for implementing physics and math.
Charge
An actor representing a point charge, which produces an electric field radially outward for positive charges and inward for negative charges.
ChargeBag
An actor representing the "charge bag" from which players drag new charges and drop unwanted charges.
DrawUtil
A static utility class containing convenient methods for drawing, such as for drawing various shapes to a Graphics2D object.
ElectricFieldHockey
The main entry-point class for the application, which creates the window containing the game.
Game
The main class that handles running and maintaining the game, i.e., the "engine," running it within a JPanel.
Goal
The target the player guides the puck into.
Goal.Orientation
Enumeration of the four possible directions of the goal, with each direction corresponding to the side that the goal's open mouth faces
HasBField
An interface implemented by Actors that provide a magnetic (B) field.
HasEField
An interface implemented by Actors that provide an electric (E) field.
LateUpdate
An interface used by actors that need to have additional update functionality that occurs after the actors are updated normally.
Level
Stores the data for a single level: a list of objects/obstacles and their properties, parsed from a level file.
LevelSelectScene
The screen that lets the player choose which level to play.
Puck
The charged puck the player tries to guide into a goal.
RequireReset
An interface implemented by Actors whose state needs to be reset when the player presses the Reset button on a level.
Scene
An abstract class, representing an indivudal scene/page in the game.
Switch
An actor representing a circular button that when pressed by a Puck, can turn off a Wire.
TitleScene
The opening screen into the game, which allows the player to choose to go to the level select screen or the sandbox level.
TotalBField
An actor that calculates and visualizes the net magnetic field in the world due to Wires.
TotalEField
An actor that calculates and visualizes the net electric field in the world due to Charges.
UIButton
A utility class that allows for easily creating, updating, and rendering responsive clickable buttons.
UniformBField
An actor representing a rectangular region in which a uniform magnetic field is present.
UniformEField
An actor representing a rectangular region in which a uniform electric field is present.
Vector2
A utility class that represents a two-dimensional vector value, with an x- and y-component.
Vector3
A utility class that represents a three-dimensional vector value, with an x-, y-, and z-component.
Wall
An actor that represents a stationary rectangular wall in the world, which serves as the primary obstacle for the puck.
Wire
An actor representing an infinitely long current-carrying wire, which produces a magnetic field with field lines in concentric circles around the wire.
WorldScene
The Scene of the main world, which handles UI elements of the simulation, running and displaying the Actors that make up the world, and handling winning and losing.
